Susan —

Thanks — good clarity on the constraints. Attached: initial sponsor Gantt (RMK_sponsor_gantt_v1.xlsx) and a short MAP draft (MAP-draft-20270824.md) that maps the deliverables to EB touchpoints. High-level proposal:

- Week of Sep 6: MAP finalization + procurement packet to Harry
- Week of Sep 13: Leadership pre-brief (Pete + Execs) — two 45-min pre-brief options we can choose from
- Week of Sep 20: EB #1 (decision steering) — recommended primary EB window
- Week of Sep 27: EB #2 (final sign-off) — fall-back / final approval (Pete already has partial availability here)

Two EB window options are in EB_window_options.pdf — Option A prioritizes earlier steering (Sep 20) with a compressed procurement timeline; Option B shifts steering to Sep 13 with longer procurement runway but requires Pete to move his calendar.

Next steps I propose: Ben to coordinate EB invite templates and meeting owners, Marissa to lock the MAP evaluation milestones and gating criteria, Laura to confirm executive-quality pre-brief slides and runbook. Can you confirm which EB option Rivermark prefers and Pete's preferred pre-brief slot? Once we have that, Ben will circulate calendar invites and a draft agenda.

If Thursday 1pm works, I'll bring Ben and Marissa for a short alignment. If not, we'll proceed asynchronously.

Thanks —

- Acceptance criteria (hard gates): latency < 120ms p50 on sample workload, data residency confirmation, and SOC2 evidence shared.
- Eval plan owner: Rivermark technical lead + Redwood CS (Laura) — 3-day smoke tests, 5-day soak test, final validation on day 8 after EB #1.
- Contingency: if soak test fails, automatic fallback to the compatibility plan with extended procurement (target new sign-off 2 weeks out).

I've also created two EB agenda templates (concise and expanded) — concise is preferable for Pete. Marcus, Ben: recommend we propose Option A (Sep 20 steering, Sep 27 final) but mark Sep 27 as the hard sign-off fallback. Susan — can you confirm if Pete can do a 30-min pre-brief on Sep 14 AM? That would give us a 6-business-day runway before EB #1.
